items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1976-02-19
items.q: Same thing goes for Dave Brubeck

ctx.x: all right. And, uh, uh, however, the process that you described stuff

also takes place in Hindemith and Stravinsky and Bartok, and since the inception of those people, that's been going on. Same thing goes for Dave Brubeck, the same thing goes for the Jerry Mulligan groups and so on.

But it's obvious that the Modern Jazz Quartet and Dave Brubeck are not, they are not playing European chamber music. They may be playing some derivative of it, but they're not playing it. It's not the same as when you hear Hindemith, you're not hearing Dave Brubeck.
